PLD 2023 Punjab Statutes 239
PLD 2023 Punjab Statutes 239
PUNJAB ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION (PRODUCTION
AND CONSUMPTION OF SINGLE-USE PLASTIC PRODUCT)
REGULATIONS, 2023
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
7th June, 2023]
No.
7-31/ES-III/EPA/2023, dated 6.6.2023.---In exercise of the powers conferred under section 33 of the Punjab
Environmental Protection Act, 1997 (XXXIV of 1997), the Environmental
Protection Agency, Punjab, with the approval of the Government, is pleased to
make the following regulations:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1)
These regulations may be cited as the Punjab Environmental Protection
(Production and Consumption of Single-Use Plastic Product) Regulations, 2023.
(2) They
shall come into force at once.
2. Definitions.---(1) In the regulations, unless the context or
subject otherwise requires:
(a) "Act"
means the Punjab Environmental Protection Act, 1997 (XXXIV of 1997);
(b) "Agency"
means the Environmental Protection Agency, Punjab;
(c) "banned
single-use plastic" means any single-use plastic products specified in the
Schedule-I;
(d) "collector"
means a person, voluntarily engaged or authorized for picking up and temporary
storing of recyclable plastic waste excluding rag pickers;
(e) "consumer"
means a person either commercially or in bulk, consumes single-use plastic
product excluding the single-household users and hospitals;
(f) "Department"
means the Environment Protection Department, Government of the Punjab;
(g) "Director
General" means the Director General of the Agency;
(h) "plastic"
means material containing essential ingredient of high polymer such as
polyethylene terephthalate, high density polyethylene, poly vinyl chloride, low
density polyethylene, polypropylene, polystyrene resins and multi-materials
including acrylonitrile butadiene styrene, polyphenylene oxide, polycarbonate
and polybutylene terephthalate etc.;
(i) "plastic
waste" means and includes non-recyclable or non-consumable plastic
material, once discarded, cause adverse environmental effects;
(j) "plastic
packaging" means all types of flexible or non-flexible plastic packaging
including but not limited to shopping bags, garbage bags, snacks packs, water
and milk packaging, shrink wraps, bubble pellet wraps, films, liners, woven or
non-woven bags, much, films, sachets excluding disposable plastic packaging,
whether used for food or non-food items;
(k) "producer"
means a person engaged in manufacture, transformation or import of single-use
plastic product;
(l) "recycler"
means a person engaged in the process of recycling of plastic waste;
(m) "recycling"
means the process of transformation or segregation of plastic waste into a new
product or raw material for production of new products but does not include
hospital plastic waste other than non-risk plastic waste;
(n) "regulations"
means the Punjab Environmental Protection (Production and Consumption of
Single-Use Plastic Product) Regulations, 2023;
(o) "Schedule"
means the Schedule appended to the regulations; and
(p) "single-use
plastic product" means any plastic item or product, or packaging intended
to be used once before being disposed of or recycled as specified in the
Schedule-II.
(2) A
word or expression used but not defined in the regulations shall have the same
meaning as assigned to it in the Act and the rules made thereunder.
3. Prohibitions.---(1) No person shall engage in the production,
consumption, distribution and storage, etc., of the banned single-use plastic.
(2) Subject
to rule 4, a person may produce, consume, distribute, store and recycle the
single-use plastic product under a licence issued by the Agency.
4. Registration.---(1) The existing producer, consumer, collector
and recycler of single-use plastic product; shall get himself registered with
the Agency within a period of twelve months from the commencement of the
regulations.
(2) Every
new producer, consumer, collector and recycler of single-use plastic product,
shall get himself registered with the Agen

shall be punished in accordance with subsection
(2) of section 17 of the Act.
